product.name: Athelas Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Suite
product.description: An AI-powered platform that automates and manages medical billing, claims processing, denial management, and revenue recovery for healthcare practices.

product.name: Ambient AI
product.description: An AI-driven clinical documentation assistant that listens to patient encounters and generates structured, customizable clinical notes automatically.

product.name: AIR (AI-powered Electronic Health Record)
product.description: An integrated electronic health record system with embedded AI features for ambient scribing, coding, scheduling, billing, and patient engagement.

product.name: Autonomous AI Receptionist
product.description: An AI agent that answers inbound patient calls 24/7, handling scheduling, intake, and general inquiries without human intervention.

product.name: AI-Powered Clinical and Administrative Assistants
product.description: Customizable AI assistants embedded within the EHR to support clinical decision-making, documentation, coding, billing, and operational tasks.

product.name: Practice Manager
product.description: An agentic practice management suite that orchestrates AI agents for healthcare billing, scheduling, claims, revenue-cycle operations, and patient communication.
